events.title: Oil Edges Higher In Cautious Trade As Dollar Dips
events.description: Gold prices traded firm on Friday after rising over 1 percent in the previous session on a weaker dollar and falling bond yields.

events.title: Oil Set For Weekly Gain With Focus On Mideast Supply Risks
events.description: Oil prices edged lower on Friday but headed for a weekly gain amid mounting supply concerns in the Middle East.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher As Tech Stocks Recover
events.description: European stocks traded higher on Friday, after hitting their highest in more than two weeks the previous day on the back of solid earnings and softening global bond yields.

events.title: Asian Shares Surge After Warsh Comments
events.description: Asian stocks advanced on Friday as tech shares bounced back following Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's comments at the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok that artificial intelligence is a major force in the global economy.

events.title: Malaysia GDP Growth Moderates To 5.3%
events.description: Malaysia's economic growth moderated to one-year low in the third quarter but the overall pace of expansion remained robust as strong global demand for electronics used in artificial intelligence bolstered the manufacturing sector. Gross domestic product grew 5.3 percent in the third quarter from the last year, advance estimates from the Department of Statistics showed Friday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Broadly Higher At Open
events.description: European stocks are seen opening broadly higher on Friday as a selloff in chip stocks eased and bond markets stabilized following a heavy sell-off earlier in the week, triggered by AI debt concerns.

events.title: Pound Rises Ahead Of Fed Warsh's Speech
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, as traders now look to U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh's speech.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher In Choppy Trade; IT Stocks Extend Surge
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher in choppy trade on Friday after posting strong gains in the previous session, led by banking and information technology stocks.

events.title: Pound Rises Against Majors
events.description: The British pound strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: Antipodean Currencies Rise Amid Risk-on Mood
events.description: The Antipodean currencies such as the Australia and the New Zealand dollars strengthened against their major currencies in the Asian session on Friday, as Asian stock markets traded higher, boosted by strong gains in Japan and South Korea amid a rebound in technology and semiconductor stocks after the recent sell-off on concerns over rising costs of financing AI investments.

events.title: Australian Dollar Advances Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Friday.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is maintaining its early gains in mid-market moves on Friday, reversing the losses in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving up to near the 8,800 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining a technology stocks.
